name: Corporate Family — Pay My Fucking Bills
subject: A furious raccoon in a loosened office tie, ripping a corporate pizza-party invitation while holding an overdue bill, a single insulting pizza slice on a plate. Cartoon hands clearly formed, angry satirical mascot.
description: Your boss called you family. Funny how the bills still have your name on them.

name: Minimum Wage — Maximum Fuck You
subject: A defiant scruffy opossum in a shabby generic work vest holding a tiny paycheck and giving one unmistakable middle finger with the other cartoon hand. Miserable time clock, crumpled receipts and empty coffee cup.
description: A tiny paycheck deserves a very large attitude. For anyone whose patience costs more than their hourly rate.

name: Raised Wrong — Still Your Fucking Problem
subject: An adult feral raccoon wearing an old latchkey around its neck, seated on a battered television beside a broken toy bear and a childhood report card, defiant grin and a smoking cereal bowl. Dysfunctional nostalgia, no actual child depicted.
description: Bad examples. Excellent survival skills. Some baggage deserves its own shirt.

name: My Childhood — Paid My Therapist’s Mortgage
subject: A battered stitched-up stuffed teddy bear reclining on an enormous psychiatrist couch, clutching a tiny house-shaped bill, beside a tall stack of therapy invoices and a therapist raven with a clipboard. Wry, bitter, unsettling childhood nostalgia.
description: A lifetime of material. Somebody’s second home had to come from somewhere.

name: Check Engine — Fuck My Life
subject: A rusted unbranded compact car with its engine exploding into unpaid bills, bolts and greasy smoke, a huge engine warning icon overhead, an exhausted skeleton mechanic facepalming beside it. No gore, detailed garage satire.
description: The dashboard lit up. Your bank account shut down. Another beautiful day owning a shitbox.

name: Shitbox — Financial Hostage
subject: A scruffy opossum mechanic attached by an absurd cartoon ball-and-chain to a rusted unbranded pickup truck, clutching a repair bill longer than its body. Flat tire, oil puddle, falling bumper, large iconic illustration.
description: You own the truck. The repair bills own you.

name: Live, Laugh — Fuck the Landlord
subject: A furious tenant raccoon in a bathrobe seated beneath a leaking roof, clutching an enormous rent invoice in a crooked run-down apartment, buckets everywhere, comically fancy crown on the building. Class satire, no violence.
description: Premium rent. Discount repairs. A luxury experience, according to the person collecting the check.

name: Rent Is Due — So Is the Revolution
subject: An angry rat tenant raising a house key like a protest symbol, standing in front of a crooked apartment tower with enormous padlocks and rent invoices, defiant raised fist and cracked gold crown. Dramatic class satire, no weapons or violence.
description: They raised the rent. You raised an eyebrow—and everything else.

name: My Ex — Was a Fucking Warning Label
subject: A battered heart-shaped shipping crate wrapped in red caution tape, a smug black cat holding an absurdly long warning-tag chain beside a bouquet of wilted roses. Acidic breakup satire, bold heart and caution geometry.
description: You saw the red flags. You called them decoration. This is the souvenir.

name: Love Is Blind — Divorce Is Expensive
subject: Two bitter cartoon vultures in rumpled wedding attire separated by a cracked heart, lawyers' invoices flowing from it, torn marriage papers and a wilted bouquet below. Darkly funny, elegant grotesque vintage relationship satire.
description: Till debt do us part. Two vultures, one broken heart, and plenty of billable hours.

name: Fuck Around — Keep the Receipts
subject: A guilty grinning raccoon holding a smoking instant camera and a ludicrous roll of evidence receipts, a tiny evidence board with snapshots of spilled drinks and broken furniture. Chaotic adult regret and bad choices, no instruction for crime.
description: Some nights become memories. Others become evidence. Keep your paperwork organized.

name: Bad Influence — Worse Fucking Ideas
subject: A manic opossum mad scientist with goggles holding a fizzing bottle beside a shopping-cart rocket assembled from junk, warning triangles and smoke curls, wild grin. Entirely fictional cartoon absurdity, bold energetic silhouette.
description: The person your friends warn their friends about. Big attitude, deeply questionable judgment.
